I am a graduate student in BIS at the Australian National University. I can delve into technical details while always keeping business objectives in mind.

I am proficient in using Python for data analysis and machine learning modeling, and I enjoy transforming complex data results into clear, understandable charts for the team through data visualization. I truly enjoy the challenges that come with identifying problems and validating ideas.

I believe the greatest value of data lies in its application, and I am eager to work with the team to provide solid, powerful support for business decisions through data.
